parsed.answer: This is a known problem: a WSL update or installer leaves the install incomplete, so system.vhd and tools\modules.vhd are missing from C:\Program Files\WSL. WSL2 then fails with Wsl/Service/CreateInstance/CreateVm/HCS/ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND. Your 2.7.14 installer exiting silently matches the failed installer runs reported in those tickets. Your rollback to 2.7.13 is consistent with the rollback fix other users reported (they rolled back to 2.6.3), and the maintainers said rolling back works. Stay on 2.7.13 for now. If you want to move to the latest version, the maintainers' recommended fix in #40488 is to exit Docker Desktop, then download the current MSI from the WSL releases page, right-click it and choose Show more options > Repair. #40808 reports that running `msiexec /fa wsl.<version>.x64.msi /l*v repair.log` from the folder with the MSI also repaired the install when the normal installer would not run. The maintainers said the underlying bug was fixed in 2.9.3 and backported to 2.7.14, but the fix only applies when updating from an already-fixed version. That is probably why `wsl --update` from your older build still broke. Your distro data is not touched by any of this.
